how: a fresh --user-data-dir for each launch, at the local echo server with session tickets off; every connection's ClientHello read
note: the payload of the GREASE encrypted_client_hello extension, drawn afresh for every connection from four lengths, each as likely: before the 16-byte AEAD tag, 128, 160, 192 and 224 bytes. The extension is 42 bytes longer than its payload. kdf 1 is HKDF-SHA256, aead 1 AES-128-GCM.
